description: Copilot CLI extension hooks for the Persona Switcher parallel dispatch workflow.

hooks.name: onSessionStart
hooks.description: Reads predefined-persona-models.json once at session start and injects a compact profile summary plus routing rules as additionalContext. Eliminates redundant per-runner manifest reads (up to 9× per parallel run).

hooks.name: onUserPromptSubmitted
hooks.description: Detects persona-switcher invocation patterns in the user prompt (keywords: persona-switcher, full-team, preset names, run-task-with-personas). When detected, injects a reminder that runner agent types require the 'persona-switcher:' namespace prefix before the orchestrator makes dispatch decisions.

hooks.name: onPreToolUse
hooks.purpose: Dispatch guard, namespace auto-fix, and dispatch logger
hooks.description: Intercepts task tool calls targeting persona runner agents. If the agent_type is missing the 'persona-switcher:' prefix, silently prepends it and logs a warning. Logs an ephemeral dispatch message for each correctly-namespaced runner call. Increments the batch dispatch counter for completion tracking.

hooks.name: onPostToolUse
hooks.description: Tracks completion of persona runner task calls. Logs '✅ Route complete (n/total)' for each completed route. Fires a persistent '🎉 All N persona routes complete' summary log when the full parallel batch finishes. Resets batch counters when a new batch starts.

hooks.name: onErrorOccurred
hooks.description: Handles recoverable errors with targeted retry strategies: model_call errors retry up to 2 times; tool_execution errors retry once with a user notification. Non-recoverable errors abort with a clear message.

hooks.name: onSessionEnd
hooks.description: Writes a brief status message to the console when the session ends.
